decisions.decision: Claude does all the prep now so launch takes one step once T-057 and T-056 clear. (1) Write a launch kit on this task: a per-member table of name, referral code and link from T-211, and the Tantra connect status, which starts as not connected. (2) Write a one-page guide for each member on connecting their LinkedIn in Tantra with credentials, not cookies, as Adi corrected on 2026-09-25. (3) Draft the first campaign config: the T-056 list segment, a {first_line} slot for T-059, the member's referral link, and caps set to the T-057 values, with a placeholder until Bharath records them. (4) Add per-member reply and registration columns to the referral dashboard. Do not launch any campaign until T-057 has Bharath's yes and caps and T-056 is imported. Then each member connects their own profile and the campaign starts within the caps.
